# Scoped constructor arguments from an original integer getter

The original virtual/interface size() result is captured once before same-owner
constructor delegation. It remains a computed integer beside float bits and a
complete nested owner-scoped callback. Four frozen routes compare 96 cases twice
for source/SDK interface declarations, compiling every source and auditing all
original entries and metadata. Dynamic receiver effects, getter snapshots,
negative values, null/raw inputs, overload choice, partial writes and exact
callee failures remain visible. Six wrong programs and six unchanged-Code
Signature controls protect the proof. Only authored fixtures execute.
